articles.summary: Lucy Frazer KC has seen the pressures on public institutions from the inside. A former Cabinet minister and twice Solicitor General, she served in six government departments, with ministerial roles across courts, prisons, probation, legal services and criminal law. Today, she takes on an expanded role at Legora, leading our work with governments and public agencies, starting in the UK and EMEA. We asked Lucy about what she saw during her time in government, why she chose Legora, and what public bodies should expect from any AI supplier before they can trust it.
articles.title: Lucy Frazer KC on why trust is a precondition for public sector AI
